title: 本月 GMV（元）
sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(total_amount),2) FROM orders WHERE status IN ('已完成','已发货') AND strftime('%Y-%m',created_at)=strftime('%Y-%m','now') LIMIT 200

title: 上月 GMV（元）
sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(total_amount),2) FROM orders WHERE status IN ('已完成','已发货') AND strftime('%Y-%m',created_at)=strftime('%Y-%m','now','-1 month') LIMIT 200

title: 本月订单数
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders WHERE strftime('%Y-%m',created_at)=strftime('%Y-%m','now') LIMIT 200

title: 本月客单价（元）
sql: SELECT ROUND(AVG(total_amount),2) FROM orders WHERE status IN ('已完成','已发货') AND strftime('%Y-%m',created_at)=strftime('%Y-%m','now') LIMIT 200

title: 本月取消订单数
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders WHERE status='已取消' AND strftime('%Y-%m',created_at)=strftime('%Y-%m','now') LIMIT 200

title: 本月 Top5 城市 GMV
sql: SELECT c.city, ROUND(SUM(o.total_amount),2) FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id=c.id WHERE o.status IN ('已完成','已发货') AND strftime('%Y-%m',o.created_at)=strftime('%Y-%m','now') GROUP BY c.city ORDER BY SUM(o.total_amount) DESC LIMIT 5

title: 本月 Top5 品类销售额
sql: SELECT cat.name, ROUND(SUM(oi.amount),2) FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.id=oi.order_id JOIN products p ON p.id=oi.product_id JOIN categories cat ON cat.id=p.category_id WHERE o.status IN ('已完成','已发货') AND strftime('%Y-%m',o.created_at)=strftime('%Y-%m','now') GROUP BY cat.id ORDER BY SUM(oi.amount) DESC LIMIT 5

title: 近 6 个月 GMV 趋势
sql: SELECT strftime('%Y-%m',created_at), ROUND(SUM(total_amount),2) FROM orders WHERE status IN ('已完成','已发货') GROUP BY strftime('%Y-%m',created_at) ORDER BY strftime('%Y-%m',created_at) DESC LIMIT 6
